title: Change password
forced_notice: You are using a temporary password. Choose a new password to continue.
intro: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
hint: At least 12 characters, with an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter and a digit.
mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
retry_after: You can try again in about {{ minutes }} min.
success: Your password was changed. Your other devices were signed out.
